[Source 1] (ID: 17-11-0307)
Subject: Establishment of DAMU
QUESTION: GOVERNMENT OF INDIA 
MINISTRY OF EARTH SCIENCES 
LOK SABHA 
STARRED QUESTION NO. *307 
TO BE ANSWERED ON WEDNESDAY, 22ND MARCH, 2023 
 
ESTABLISHMENT OF DAMU 
 
*307. DR. T. SUMATHY (a) THAMIZHACHI THANGAPANDIAN: 
SHRI ARUN SAO: 
 
Will the Minister of EARTH SCIENCES be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether the Government has established District Agro-Meteorological Field Units 
(DAMU) in each state which are responsible for preparing and disseminating district 
and sub-district level agro-met advisories; 
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not, the reasons therefor; 
(c) the details of the fund allocated to establish the DAMU network; 
(d) whether the Government has any information on the number of Doppler Weather 
Radars (DWR) installed to predict extreme weather events in the country including 
Chhattisgarh and Karnataka during the last five years; and 
(e) if so, the details thereof and if not, the reasons therefor?
ANSWER: (a) to (e): A Statement is laid on the Table of the House. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
STATEMENT LAID ON THE TABLE OF THE LOK SABHA IN REPLY TO (a) to (e) OF 
STARRED QUESTION NO. *307 REGARDING “ESTABLISHMENT OF DAMU” TO BE 
ANSWERED ON, MARCH 22, 2023 
 
(a) & (b) Yes Sir. District Agromet Units (DAMUs) have been established at Krishi Vigyan 
Kendras (KVKs) in collaboration with Indian Council of Agricultural 
Research(ICAR) to implement block level Agrometeorological Advisory Services 
(AAS). Till date, 199 District Agromet Units (DAMUs) have been established at 
KVKs across the country under ICAR network. These DAMUs prepare district and 
block level Agromet Advisories based on district and block level weather forecasts 
for their respective districts and communicate to the farmers on every Tuesday and 
Friday. Block level weather forecast and Agromet Advisories aid the farmers in 
taking decision on day-to-day agricultural operations. The information on State-wise 
network of DAMU has been given in Annexure I. 
 
(c) The year-wise details of funds released to ICAR under GKMS for DAMU network is 
furnished below : 
 
S. No. Financial year Amount released (in crores) 
1) 2022-23 31.00 
2) 2021-22 11.00 
3) 2020-21 04.00 
4) 2019-20 14.07 
5) 2018-19 07.60 
 
(d) - (e) India Meteorological Department (IMD) has installed about 37 Doppler Weather 
Radars (DWRs) in the country. The existing DWR network, wherein the States of 
Chhattisgarh and Karnataka are also catered in is provided in Annexure-II. During 
last five years 11 DWRs have been installed and the list is given below :
